title: SentinelObservations
description: Per-voyage sentinel observation bundle: clinical line list plus wastewater samples, keyed to a voyage_config itinerary. Consumed by picard_framework/analysis/sentinel; see docs/sentinel/sentinel_surveillance_spec.md.

observation_end_epoch.description: Last epoch under observation. Onsets after this epoch are unobserved (right censoring).

exposure_totals.description: Person-hours ashore per port_id — the hazard denominator. Observed from the run rather than inferred from itinerary fractions.

truth_introductions.description: Simulated ground truth: which person acquired at which port. Present only for synthetic voyages (no field dataset has it); used to score hazard recovery, never as model input.

onset_epoch.description: 1-indexed epoch of symptom onset (not of report).

genotype.description: Genotype this case was typed as by a delivered sequencing assay — the reported call, which accuracy can make wrong, not the host's true lineage. Null when the case was never typed (no strain tracking, no assay, or a specimen that failed its Ct gate or read floor).

hours_ashore.description: Hours ashore per port_id for this person. Keys must exist in the voyage itinerary; 0 or omitted means stayed aboard.

reported_via.description: Detection channel; drives the reporting-probability term of the observation model.

report_epoch.description: Epoch the case entered surveillance, if later than onset.

collection_point.description: Wastewater collection zone label (CTB sequencing modality zone).

pathogen_id.description: ABM pathogen profile id the sample counted infections of (e.g. norwalk_gi). 'pathogen' is the delay-catalog key the fit filters on, and the two are deliberately different vocabularies — but a truth-vs-observed join needs the id, so it is carried here. Empty when the run did not name one; 'pathogen' is then the only key available.

assay_mode.description: Laboratory mode that produced the row. Absent means metagenomic, the mode that predates the switch. Read fields and concentration fields are alternatives: qpcr rows have no library, metagenomic rows have no Ct.

total_reads.description: Library depth. pathogen_reads <= total_reads is enforced by the loader. Omitted or 0 for a mode that does not sequence, and 0 for a sequencing mode whose sample failed the detection gate (no library is made off a negative well).

clr_anomaly_score.description: GRUMB centered-log-ratio anomaly score for this pathogen.

ct_value.description: Reported cycle threshold. Null for a non-detect: a negative well has no Ct, and the evidence is the bound in lod_copies_per_l.

detected.description: Whether the sample cleared the assay's limit of detection. Null for modes with no detection gate.

concentration_copies_per_l.description: Genome copies per litre implied by the reported Ct, or supplied by an external qPCR dataset. Null for a non-detect and for compositional metagenomics, which does not measure copies/L.

lod_copies_per_l.description: Copies/L at the assay's limit of detection — the censoring point a non-detect observes.

turnaround_hours.description: Instrument turnaround for a confirmatory (long-read) run.

genotype.description: Consensus lineage of the sample: the most abundant lineage the library resolved, the configured long-read reference, or null when nothing was typed.

lineage_status.description: Outcome of strain deconvolution on this library. 'not_configured' when the assay does not attempt it, 'no_composition' when the pool carries no tracked lineage, 'insufficient_reads'/'below_reporting_floor' when the library could not resolve one.

lineage_calls.description: Lineages reported from the on-target reads, most abundant first. Reads sum to at most pathogen_reads; the remainder is lineage_unresolved_reads.

lineage_unresolved_reads.description: On-target reads not attributed to any reported lineage: below the reporting floor, or from pool mass whose lineage is untracked.
